cards.text: Veto a question.

cards.name: Randomize
cards.text: Randomize a question.

cards.name: Duplicate
cards.text: Duplicate another card in your hand.

cards.name: Move
cards.text: Move to a new hiding bar.

cards.name: Discard 1, Draw 2
cards.text: Discard 1 card, draw 2.

cards.name: Discard 2, Draw 3
cards.text: Discard 2 cards, draw 3.

cards.name: Red Bonus (2 min)
cards.text: +2 minutes to the hider's time.

cards.name: Orange Bonus (4 min)
cards.text: +4 minutes to the hider's time.

cards.name: Yellow Bonus (6 min)
cards.text: +6 minutes to the hider's time.

cards.name: Green Bonus (8 min)
cards.text: +8 minutes to the hider's time.

cards.name: Blue Bonus (12 min)
cards.text: +12 minutes to the hider's time.

cards.name: Take a Shot to Double Next Question Rewards
cards.text: Take a shot to double the rewards from the next question.

cards.name: Cheers
cards.text: One team member from each team must drink asap.

cards.name: Drinks All Round
cards.text: Everyone on both teams must drink asap.

cards.name: Curse of Distant Cuisine
cards.text: Find a restaurant within your zone that serves food from a specific foreign country. The seekers must visit a restaurant serving food from a country that is a greater distance away before asking their next question.

params.hider_proof_prompt: Photo of your restaurant or its menu, showing which country the food is from.
params.proof_prompt: Photo at a restaurant serving food from a country further away.

cards.name: Curse of Unguided Tourist
cards.text: Send the seekers an unzoomed Google Street View image from a street within 150 m of where they are now. The shot has to be parallel to the horizon and include at least one human-built structure other than a road. Without using the internet for research, they must find what you sent them in real life before asking another question. They must send a picture to the hider for verification.

params.hider_proof_prompt: Unzoomed Street View screenshot from a street within 150 m of the seekers: level with the horizon, with a structure other than a road in it.
params.proof_prompt: Photo of the same spot in real life.

cards.name: Curse of Bird Guide
cards.text: You have one chance to film a bird for as long as possible, up to 5 minutes straight. If, at any point, the bird leaves the frame, the timer is stopped. The seekers must then film a bird for the same amount of time or longer before asking another question.

params.hider_proof_prompt: Film a bird in one take, up to 5 minutes. Stop when it leaves the frame.
params.proof_prompt: Film a bird for at least as long as the hiders' video.
params.judge_question: Did the seekers film their bird for as long or longer?

cards.name: Curse of Luxury Car
cards.text: Take a photo of a car. The seekers must take a photo of a more expensive car before asking another question.

params.proof_prompt: Photo of a more expensive car.
params.judge_question: Is the seekers' car more expensive?

cards.name: Curse of Bridge
cards.text: The seekers must ask their next question from under a bridge.

params.proof_prompt: Photo of you under a bridge.

cards.name: Curse of Right Turn
cards.text: For the next 20 minutes, the seekers can only turn right at any street intersection. If at any point they find themselves in a dead end where they cannot continue, they may do a full 180.

cards.name: Curse of Jammed Door
cards.text: For the next 30 minutes, whenever the seekers want to pass through a doorway into a building, they must roll two dice. If they don't roll above a 7, they cannot enter that space. Each doorway can be re-attempted after 5 minutes.

cards.name: Curse of U-Turn
cards.text: The seekers must disembark their current mode of transportation at the next station (as long as that station is serviced by another form of transit in the next 30 minutes).

cards.name: Curse of Drained Brain
cards.text: Choose three questions in different categories. The seekers cannot ask those questions for the rest of the run.

cards.name: Curse of Express Route
cards.text: Seekers can't disembark transport for 5 minutes.

cards.name: Curse of Menu
cards.text: Hiders must pick a drink from their bar menu (any branded alcohol). Seekers need to find the same one and drink it before asking another question.

params.hider_proof_prompt: Photo of the drink on your bar's menu (any branded alcohol).
params.proof_prompt: Photo of you drinking the same drink.

cards.name: Curse of Prison
cards.text: If seekers are in your chosen hiding bar when this is played, they are locked there for 10 minutes and draw a card. You must tell them they are at your bar.

params.seeker_confirm: Are you in the hiders' bar right now?

cards.name: Curse of Pokies
cards.text: Seekers cannot ask any more questions until successfully winning the pokies.

cards.name: Curse of Clash
cards.text: Seekers can't use any transport until beating the hiders at Clash Royale.

params.proof_prompt: Screenshot of your win against the hiders.

cards.name: Curse of Sculling
cards.text: Hiders get one chance to chug a schooner / pint on video (that is the casting cost, no extra drink). Seekers can't use transport until they chug one quicker on video. The hiders watch both and pick who was quicker.

params.hider_proof_prompt: Film your team chugging a schooner / pint in one take. This is the casting cost.
params.proof_prompt: Film yourselves chugging a schooner / pint quicker than the hiders.

cards.name: Curse of Escape
cards.text: Seekers have 3 minutes to exit a bar. Any drinks ordered must be finished before they can leave. If they don't leave in time, they are locked in the bar for 10 minutes.

params.not_applicable: Only if you are in a bar when it lands.

cards.name: Curse of Impression
cards.text: Seekers must spin the impression wheel. They cannot ask any more questions until a stranger guesses their character correctly.

cards.name: Curse of Hammered
cards.text: Seekers roll a die. The number indicates the amount of shots they must drink before asking another question. Shots can be distributed across team members.

params.proof_prompt: Photo of the shots you rolled.

cards.name: Curse of Quan
cards.text: Seekers must lose a game of pool before asking their next question.

params.proof_prompt: Photo of the pool table after you lost.

cards.name: Curse of Moll
cards.text: Seekers must get 1 of 3 Harry Potter trivia questions right before using transport. If all three are wrong, the hider sends three new ones. No Googling.

cards.name: Curse of Louis
cards.text: Seekers must ask their next question from inside a Chinese restaurant, or from Chinatown in the Valley.

params.proof_prompt: Photo inside the Chinese restaurant or in Chinatown.

cards.name: Curse of Cruz
cards.text: Seekers must ask their next question from inside a KFC, or after eating something watermelon flavoured.

params.proof_prompt: Photo inside KFC or of the watermelon-flavoured thing.

cards.name: Curse of Nathan
cards.todo: No text yet; copies set to 0 so it stays out of the deck

cards.name: Curse of Brothel
cards.text: The seeking team must take a shot for every 3 people in VC on the Discord at the time this card is played. @ing people to join beforehand is allowed, but the hiders can also disconnect people.
cards.todo: Idea card, not in the first-game deck; set copies above 0 to use it

notes: Curse values are the small-game values (left-most of [small, medium, large] on the cards).
